quotes.text: The review asked to replace thread-card-container with the generic card-container because the container served both message and address book cards. The final patch changed message markup, common CSS, and browser_cardsView.js to use card-container; current markup and tree CSS keep that name. The browser test queries the class and checks the card height. When a class becomes shared, use one generic name at all consumers and update tests that select it. CSS classes in this area use lowercase words joined by hyphens; scope this naming observation to these tree and card components.
